existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increase in small intestine steatosis describes the same steatosis process as liver steatosis but in a different organ context, warranting grouping under similar_event_different_biological_context; however, the existing group type is 'merge' so assigning to the closest appropriate group — small intestine steatosis should be flagged against liver_steatosis as a different biological context.

new_groups.rationale: Increase in small intestine steatosis describes the same steatosis process as liver steatosis (existing liver_steatosis group) but in a different organ; flagging as a single-member note pending curator pairing with liver steatosis events.

Decreased MMP (matrix metalloproteinase activity) and decreased trophoblast invasion/migration are causally linked — MMPs facilitate trophoblast invasion — but represent distinct biological events (enzyme activity vs. cellular behavior) on related but different objects.
